name: Achilló
subtitle: Jon's Achilles rehab log
description: Private AltStore source for the Achilló rehab app. Builds are published by the app's build script.

apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Pocket mode: tap the phone icon during a session for a black screen that ignores touches (hold 1 second to come back); vibrations keep working. New strip at the bottom shows every exercise in the session and how far you are.
Letting go after a hold (eversion, inversion, plantarflexion isometrics) now uses the lowering vibration. Before, it was a single faint tap.
Each rep's notch is now painted as it happens: dull at the start of the push, full orange through the hold, fading as you lower — so finished reps show the history of each one.
